item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 21/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will reach southern China tomorrow. The weather will be generally fine over the region in the following few days. It will be appreciably cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the seas east of the Philippines will intensify gradually and move towards the vicinity of Luzon in the next couple of days. It will have a higher chance to enter the northeastern part of the South China Sea. However, there are uncertainties in its subsequent movement. It may move westwards across the central and northern parts of the South China Sea or take a northwestward track edging closer to the coast of southern China. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China in the latter part of this week. Under the combined effect of the northeast monsoon and the tropical cyclone, it will be windy with a few showers over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week and early next week.
